overall: The AG found the Licensing Board violated the Open Meeting Law by not making requested minutes available, or stating they did not exist, within 10 calendar days of an OML request, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to timely respond to a February 1, 2026 request under the Open Meeting Law for PDF copies of its 2024-2026 minutes.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
